block.discord.model.title: Discord
block.discord.model.description: Send and read Discord channel messages with a bot or a webhook.
block.discord.security_hint: The bot token and webhook URL stay in the wallet. Nothing is sent until Allow writes is enabled; delete also needs Allow delete.
block.discord.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.discord.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.discord.help_enabled: Off by default. While off, no request reaches Discord and the wallet is never read.
block.discord.help_secret_ref: Wallet reference holding the bot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Needed to send, read, react, upload and watch. Never the token itself.
block.discord.help_webhook_secret_ref: Optional wallet reference holding a channel webhook URL, for webhook_send notifications without a bot.
block.discord.help_allowed_channels: JSON array of channel IDs the bot may use, for example ["1234567890123456789"]. Required with a bot token. Copy an ID with Developer Mode on.
block.discord.help_default_channel: Used when a request gives no channel_id; it must be in the allowed list.
block.discord.help_default_operation: Operation used for plain text and for JSON without operation: the bot (send_message) or the webhook (webhook_send).
block.discord.help_mentions: Who may be pinged. none: nobody; users: mentioned users; users_roles: users and roles; all: also @everyone and @here.
block.discord.help_allow_writes: Off by default. Required to send, edit, react, upload and use the webhook.
block.discord.help_allow_delete: Separate switch for delete_message. Discord has no recycle bin: a deleted message cannot be restored.
block.discord.help_file_root: Only files inside this folder can be uploaded from the file input.
block.discord.help_max_file_bytes: Larger files are refused before anything is sent. Discord allows 10 MiB on servers without boosts.
block.discord.help_read_limit: Upper bound for one read_messages; a request limit can only lower it.
block.discord.help_watch: In Active Runtime, poll the channels for new messages and emit them on messages. One Shot polls once per watch request.
block.discord.help_watch_channels: JSON array, a subset of the allowed channels. Empty watches every allowed channel (at most 20).
block.discord.help_watch_interval_sec: At least 10 seconds between two polls of the Run listener.
block.discord.label_emit_existing: Emit recent messages on first start
block.discord.help_emit_existing: Off: the first start only records the newest message. On: messages of the window below are emitted once, in bounded polls.
block.discord.help_existing_since_hours: How far back the first start looks when Emit recent messages is on.
block.discord.help_watch_max_items: More messages wait for the next poll; none is skipped.
block.discord.help_watch_include_bots: Off by default, so the block never reacts to its own messages.
block.discord.help_page_size: limit sent with each read of channel messages, at most 100 (Discord's maximum).
block.discord.help_max_pages: Pages per read, and per channel in a watch poll.
block.discord.help_timeout_sec: Total time for one request or poll, pages, rate-limit waits and retries included.
block.discord.help_max_retries: Reads retry after HTTP 429, 5xx or a lost connection; writes only after HTTP 429.
block.discord.help_max_retry_wait_sec: A retry_after or bucket reset above this value returns rate_limited instead of waiting.
block.discord.help_max_response_bytes: Larger Discord responses are refused as protocol errors.
block.discord.help_api_base_url: Keep https://discord.com. Another origin receives the token; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.
block.discord.help_ca_file: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
